taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-02 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 31374.7 | 20.07 | 20.07
2 | 7559.9 | 12.79 | 32.86
3 | 3573.3 | 1.62 | 34.48
4 | 313.2 | 38.90 | 73.38
5 | 53.6 | 0.41 | 73.79
6 | 22.8 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as Q-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-02
Curve type: Q-type (resistivity decreases monotonically with depth: 31374.7 → 7559.9 → 3573.3 → 313.2 → 53.6 → 22.8 ohm-m)
Aquifer depth: Below 73.38 m (layer 5/6 contact), with the main water-bearing zone inferred in layer 6 (22.8 ohm-m, below 73.79 m)
Recommendation: Drill through the resistive overburden (0–73.38 m) with casing to seal off the upper low-yield formations, and target the low-resistivity zone beginning near 73.4–73.8 m as the primary aquifer; confirm saturation and yield with drill cuttings and a short test pump once this horizon is reached.
